from PIL import Image

import statistics

    for y in range(H):
        p = px[x,y]

    cols.append((r/H, g/H, b/H))

# Overall stats

from collections import Counter

    h, s, v = colorsys.rgb_to_hsv(r/255, g/255, b/255)
